F10 COULD Streaks Prominently displays a streak counter, 
that increments daily after a completed 
lesson, and resets to zero after 48 hours 
of inactivity. This strategy mirrors that of 
Duolingo has highlighted by (Luis, 2023). 
If implemented this feature should also be 
appended to the pre-existing badge 
reward system, further bolstering its 
effects. 
Outcome: Enhances student retention 
rates, promoting the creation of habits.
